call_order: Shuffle observation groups each pass; shuffle seeds and presets within each group. This preserves realistic runs of the same instruction while changing call order.
note: Deterministic repeatability under changed call order; not a claim of unchanged task accuracy.

model.allocator_policy: MLX defaults; no explicit cache/memory/wired limit setters
model.cache_limit_note: No getter in this MLX build; default policy retained without setter calls
model.cache_clear_policy: loading only, before action replacement and after loading; never per request

protocol_adjustment.reason: User requested efficiency; retain two fully completed passes; optional third pass stopped with SIGTERM. Original attempt preserved.
